[Image: Diagram of angles on a straight line]

In the figure above, points A, O, and B lie on a line. OM bisects angle BOC and ON bisects angle AOC. What is the value of x?

Answer: ____

figure_description: A geometric diagram showing a straight horizontal line with points A, O, and B labeled from left to right, where O is between A and B. Three rays emanate upwards from point O into the upper half-plane: ray ON (pointing up and to the left), ray OC (pointing almost straight up, slightly to the right), and ray OM (pointing up and to the right). The angle between ray OM and ray OB is indicated with an arc labeled 40°. The angle between ray ON and ray OC is indicated with an arc labeled x°.
